observations: body L3, L6, L8-L9, L19, L22, L24-L26, L32, L34: «89,v.-90,v.» (L6) has a hyphen (3.5 pt); «al–Khāzinī» (L6), «Al–Battānī» (L9) and «al–Battānī» (L19) have long dashes (5.4 pt), as have «1–34» (L8), «31–32» (L25) and «18–19» (L32) in the heads and the reference (5.4 to 5.9 pt). The dashes after «d)», «e)» and «f)» and before «Sectio» (L3), «Al–Battānī» (L9), «Regula» (L22), «Schiaparelli» (L24) and «Constructio» (L26) and at the end of L32 measure 8.9 to 10.3 pt.
body L9, L24, L26, L33, L36: heavy brackets open Schiaparelli's additions in L9, L26 and L36 and close them in L24 and L33; the addition begun in L36 goes on to p. 272.

body L12-L16: al-Battānī's second solution (p. 88, l. 3-8 of the translation) takes 10° 5/6 = 10° 50′ when the Moon moves with its least and the Sun with its greatest motion, and 13° 2/3 = 13° 40′ when the Moon moves with its greatest and the Sun with its least. A speck 2.3 by 1.8 pt at mid-height before «minimum)» (L15) is not a hyphen.

body L18: 11° 45′ · 13/12 · 12° 11′ : 13° 40′ = 11° 20′ 51″, which the print gives as 11° 21′. The factor 13/12 adds a twelfth to the arc for the greatest distance; the inverse ratio of rule III on p. 268 for the number 0 of the third column, 1 : 1 − 1/12, would give 12/11 and 11° 25′ 37″.
body L26, L31: the translation, p. 89, l. 31-32, reads «spatium inter duos arcus est Lunae novae imago»; Schiaparelli's quotations here have «novae Lunae». The quotation of L32 is p. 90, l. 18-19.

review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
